components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When
            supplied it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand' (see Owner) as of their registrationDate.
            Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows registering an owner that shares a household
            (same last name and address) with an existing owner, bypassing the
            household-duplicate rejection. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw
                'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three of
                lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more
                than the owners already in that city.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in
                the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 4
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007-M26'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable shared identifier assigned when an owner is registered into an
                existing household (same last name and address) via 'sharesHousehold'.
                Every owner in the household carries the same value. Absent for owners
                that do not share a household.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'HH-3F9A1C2B7D0E'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on creation. Starts at 1;
                add 1 when an email address is on file; add 1 when the owner is the first
                with their name (namesakeCount is 0); capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for
                tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day before this owner was created, flagging a
                bulk-signup surge; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when an
                email address is on file, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate as of registrationDate:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or over.
                Present only when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the telephone is its E.164 form,
                the email is its lower-cased form (empty when absent) and householdId is the
                owner's shared-household id (empty when none). Two owners are duplicates only
                when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F9A1C2B7D0E'
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's
                lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same lastName and
                postcode, different telephone). Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 42
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## What changed

I replaced the direct level computation with a points system, in two places:

**`OwnerMapper.java`** — the derivation site of the old rule:
- Added `membershipPoints(Owner)`: starts at 0, `+2` email present, `+1` when `namesakeCount == 0`, `+2` for a household of 3+ members, `+3` for tenure over 365 days.
- Rewrote `membershipLevel(Owner)` to band the points: `1` (0–1), `2` (2–3), `3` (4–5), `4` (6+).
- Both fields are now emitted via `@Mapping` on `toOwnerDto`.
- Household size is counted by injecting `OwnerRepository` (field-injected into the Spring-component MapStruct impl) and counting owners sharing the same persisted `householdId` — the same `findAll` pattern `CountOwnerNamesakes` uses. This makes the factor correct on **both** the create-response and the GET-read path, since `householdId` is persisted. It degrades safely (household scores nothing) if the repository or `householdId` is absent.

**`openapi.yml`** — so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field and the schema matches:
- Added the `membershipPoints` property (integer, min 0, readOnly).
- Widened `membershipLevel` to `maximum: 4` and updated its description to the banding rule.
